record.context_brief: Riesz equilibrium support for d−3 < s < d
record.original_question: For the Riesz s-energy with radial external field V(x)=γ‖x‖^α/α on R^d, what can be said about the equilibrium measure μ_eq when d−3 < s < d? In particular, in this range, when does the minimizing equilibrium support remain a sphere, and when can it instead be a full ball or another type of set?

evidence.quote: Question 1.1 (Robert Womersley, Edward Saff). What can we say about the equilibrium measures for values of s with d − 3 < s < d?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix integers d ≥ 2 and a real parameter s with 0 < s < d. For x ∈ R^d, write ‖x‖ for the Euclidean norm, and define the Riesz s-kernel k_s(x,y) = ‖x − y‖^{−s} (interpreted as −log‖x − y‖ in the limiting case s = 0). Given an external field V : R^d → R, the weighted Riesz s-energy of a Borel probability measure μ on R^d is

   I_{s,V}(μ) = ∫∫ k_s(x,y) dμ(x) dμ(y) + 2 ∫ V(x) dμ(x).

Take the radial external field V(x) = γ ‖x‖^α / α with γ > 0 and α > max(0, −s), so that I_{s,V} admits a unique minimizer μ_eq among Borel probability measures on R^d (the equilibrium measure).

Question. For parameters s in the range d − 3 < s < d, characterize the equilibrium measure μ_eq of the functional I_{s,V}. In particular, determine for which combinations of (d, s, α, γ) the support of μ_eq is a sphere {x : ‖x‖ = R} (with μ_eq the uniform/rotation-invariant probability measure on it), for which combinations the support is a full ball {x : ‖x‖ ≤ R}, and what other support geometries can arise. Provide explicit conditions distinguishing these regimes and, where possible, an explicit formula for μ_eq.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2024–2025) by Chafaï, Saff, Womersley and collaborators gives a complete characterization of when the equilibrium support is a sphere for power-type radial external fields, and resolves the special case s = d − 3 (extending Marcel Riesz's classical ball result), where μ_eq is an arcsine-type radial distribution on a ball. However, a full description of μ_eq throughout the entire hypersingular-adjacent range d − 3 < s < d (including all transitions between sphere, ball and intermediate supports) is not yet complete, so the question is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Riesz Energy with a Radial External Field: When is the Equilibrium Support a Sphere?
status_evidence.snippet: We provide general necessary and sufficient conditions on the external field for powers of the Euclidean norm... and completely characterize the values of the power for which dimension reduction occurs (support becomes a sphere).
status_evidence.claim: Sphere-support case is characterized for power-type radial external fields.

status_evidence.title: Riesz equilibrium on a ball in the external field of a point charge
status_evidence.snippet: Quadratic-field extension of Marcel Riesz's classical result, treating s = d−3 with equilibrium given by a radial arcsine distribution on a ball.
status_evidence.claim: The case s = d−3 with quadratic external field is solved explicitly.

status_evidence.title: Radial Riesz equilibrium on a sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of when the equilibrium support is a sphere for radial external fields.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent work but full picture for d−3 < s < d remains incomplete.
